messages:
Ola P (PM): Quick sync — we need a 'dial-back' doc for the upcoming demo. Execs want clarity on what we absolutely ship in MVP vs what we promise for v1. Demo is in 11 days.

Marcus Y (Eng): Short version: MVP = routing, tenant pinning, basic tracing + canary toggle. Heavy infra (global embeddings rebuild, quant kernels) => v1. We can add a pilot-scoped prefix cache for the demo.

June K (Eng-ML): Pilot cache is fine, but add a lightweight regression check for pinned models. If output fingerprint drift >5% we auto-disable the cache for that tenant. Small scope, big safety win.

Victor H (Design): For the UI, we'll show a bold "Pilot" ribbon and a small latency badge. Also suggest a tooltip: "Pilot: limited capacity, optimized for selected customers." Keeps expectations clear.

Sam R (Sales): Pilot customers are ok with limits if called out. They want to opt-in flow and a short consent note. Will prep language.

Marcus Y (Eng): Implementation notes: prefix cache = in-memory LRU by sha256(prefix), TTL=100s, cap=1600 entries. Expose feature flag `pilot_cache.<tenant>` and a toggle in the console. Spike ~1d, integrate ~2d.

June K (Eng-ML): Regression harness: 50 prompts focusing on critical flows. Fingerprint + token-diff check. I'll land a minimal harness in ~1.5d scoped to pinned models.

Ola P (PM): Decision: MVP ships with routing + tenant pinning + pilot-scoped prefix cache + model regression harness + basic telemetry. v1 will include global embeddings cache, quantized batched path, and broad rollout.

Marcus Y (Eng): Also recommend a throttled fallback for public tenants — token-bucket per-tenant (burst 40, rate 8/s). If pilot cache misbehaves, public tenants see throttled steady-state instead of system overload. I'll add the hook.

Victor H (Design): I'll deliver the pilot ribbon and tooltip copy by EOD tomorrow.

Sam R (Sales): I'll draft the opt-in consent copy and demo script clarifying the pilot limits. Send to Ola for sign-off.

ops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy for demo branch scheduled 2025-03-12T13:00 UTC.

Ola P (PM): Quick acceptance checklist for the demo:
- console toggle for pilot_cache + pilot ribbon (Design + Eng)
- prefix cache spike + PR + integration tests (Marcus)
- regression harness + auto-disable rule (June)
- throttled fallback for public tenants (Marcus + ProdOps)
- pilot consent copy + demo script (Sam)
- file v1 backlog tickets for global cache/quant (PM)

Marcus Y (Eng): I'll start the spike today and tag the demo branch. Will ping when PR draft is ready.

June K (Eng-ML): I'll scope the regression prompts and share the set for review.

Ola P (PM): Good. If anything looks like it will slip, flag it here promptly. Reconvene Friday EOD for a quick readout. :thumbsup:
